newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, more enquries in S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, more enquries in S.Korea.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Wednesday were little changed from Tuesday's quotes with buyers heading to South Korea, traders said.
There are more ships seen calling at South Korea currently, said a trader. As a result bunkering enquiries were more active there (South Korea) compared to Singapore, he said.
Majors were offering 380-cst at $124 per tonne with independents at $120 per tonne. Bunker 180-cst were quoted between $124-$126.
MDO prices were indicated between $210 and $220 and gas oil steady at $230-$235. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
